title: Queen for a Bishop
setup: Black's bishop has come back to f8, and you have a rook on the seventh and another waiting on c2.
hint: You are not counting material here — you are counting escape squares. Find the one piece that supplies them all.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qxf8+}} looks absurd until you see that {{Kxf8}} is forced and the king is now on the rank the c2 rook commands. {{Rc8#}} ends it, with the rook on a7 covering e7, the one flight square the pawns do not take away themselves.
